facts.fact: The RPPA survey says Umucyo was rolled out to all government institutions in 2017 and is used by about 200 procuring entities and over 5,000 bidders.

The RPPA survey says Umucyo covers planning, bidding, awarding, contracting, purchasing and contract management, and law 62/2018 requires all public procurement to use it unless RPPA authorises otherwise.
The RPPA survey reports about 200 procuring entities and over 5,000 bidders on Umucyo and an overall user satisfaction of 79.5%.
